name: navbar-corner-panel
title: Navbar Corner Panel
description: A navbar that keeps its whole menu in one small frosted square in the corner. Opening it grows the square into a tall panel whose links drop in with their underlines drawing out, while the page dims behind and a lime close bubble follows the pointer.
docs:
Docs, props and examples: https://tween-ui.vercel.app/block/navbar-corner-panel
Pass your own `links` and `socials` and put your page inside as `children`; the panel sizes itself to the screen it opens on.
